title: Group chat · Weekend stories
L: Lan: Has anyone heard what happened to Bao on Saturday? It's hilarious!
Bao: Ugh, Lan! Okay, fine. I got on the wrong bus and ended up in a village I had never heard of.
Minh: No way! How far did you go?
Bao: About forty minutes. By the time I noticed, my phone had died too.
Thu: Oh no! So how did you get home?
Bao: A kind old man who was selling vegetables gave me a ride on his motorbike.
Minh: Ha! Only you could turn a bad day into an adventure.
Lan: Next time, let's all go together so nobody gets lost!

exq.q: Chỗ trống 1: Okay, fine. I got on the wrong bus and ended ___ in a village I had never heard of.
exq.why: end up in … = rốt cuộc lại ở …

exq.q: Chỗ trống 2: No ___! How far did you go?
exq.why: No way! = Không thể nào! (cách nói cố định).

exq.q: Chỗ trống 3: By the time I noticed, my phone had ___ too.
Chỗ trống 4: A kind old man ___ was selling vegetables gave me a ride on his motorbike.
exq.why: who + động từ, chỉ người (a kind old man).

exq.a: A vegetable seller gave him a ride.
exq.why: “A kind old man who was selling vegetables gave me a ride.”
